title: Legal Assistant / Client Support Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a motivated and focused person with recent experience (i.e. last 12 months) either working in an estate agency or legal experience in residential conveyancing to join our fast-growing law firm.
Juno is a law firm for the digital age. We’re on a mission to transform the experience of buying and selling a home. We make conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster.
We’re growing fast, and we’re looking for Legal Assistants / Client Support Analysts to join our enthusiastic and empathetic team.
People who’ve done this job in the past have been promoted to other roles within Juno - Paralegal, Partnerships Associate and Workflow Developer.
Juno makes conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster

• Juno is a modern law firm specialising in residential conveyancing and operating throughout England and Wales.

• We complete thousands of sale, purchase and remortgage transactions each year, and we’re trusted with panel membership by 80+ mortgage lenders.

• We’re rated as one of the best conveyancing firms in the UK by our clients (4.9/5 on Trustpilot) and estate agents and brokers frequently tell us how much they enjoy working with us.

• We’ve built our own software in-house. Clients can do all their conveyancing online, and always know what’s going on. And we’ve optimised the process to complete transactions 50% faster than the average law firm.

About the role

• You’ll be the first point of contact on either phones or emails for the day, providing updates and answering questions to ensure everyone has a great experience of Juno.

• For more complex matters you’ll be working directly with our legal teams to transfer calls internally, take messages or escalate complex emails.

• You’ll help to progress cases by chasing clients, other law firms and third parties for outstanding documents and information.

• You’ll be uploading legal documents and information to our system.

• Help maintain an excellent client experience by ensuring communication is clear, timely and jargon-free.

• You don’t need a law degree but it’s a bonus.

•
This is a work-from-home role with normal full time working hours between 9am-6pm, Monday to Friday.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys speaking with clients and thrives in a busy environment. It’s a great opportunity to develop your career in the legal sector while gaining hands-on experience in property law and conveyancing within a fast-paced, supportive team.

Flexible working
More than 60% of people at Juno have flexible working hours, and 30% work part-time (typically four days a week). At Juno, we believe in a healthy work-life balance. Our flexible working patterns help make room for life’s commitments whilst keeping the team running smoothly.
In exchange we expect our people to treat their home working the same as if they were in an office - with dedication, concentration and minimum distractions during working hours. We expect childcare to be in place for all working hours in the same way it would be if you worked in an office.
Each person’s needs are unique, and we aim to build teams with a mixture of working patterns which are mutually supportive.

De beschikbare data bevatten onder meer informatie over vervoersstromen, herkomst en bestemming, corridors, ladingen en lossingen, tonnages, doorvaarten en andere reiskenmerken. De opdracht onderzoekt in welke mate technologie relevante evoluties automatisch kan signaleren, mogelijke verklarende parameters kan identificeren en de sterkte en onzekerheid van verbanden transparant kan weergeven.
Het gaat nadrukkelijk om een ondersteunend analyse-instrument en niet om een autonoom beslissingssysteem. Inhoudelijke validatie door de eindorganisatie blijft noodzakelijk. De opdracht moet bovendien aantonen of deze aanpak technisch, organisatorisch en operationeel haalbaar is binnen de bestaande ICT-context.

• Een proof of concept ontwerpen, bouwen, testen, documenteren en overdraagbaar opleveren.

• Trendwijzigingen, afwijkingen en trendbreuken in trafiekdata automatisch detecteren en analyseren.

• Directe en indirecte verbanden onderzoeken tussen trafiekdata en interne of externe verklarende variabelen.

• Rapporteren op een transparante manier over bron, methode, sterkte van verbanden, onzekerheid, beperkingen en reproduceerbaarheid.

• Een werkend en testbaar prototype opleveren binnen de goedgekeurde projectomgeving.

• Rekening houden met functionaliteit, beveiliging, technische haalbaarheid, toegangsbeheer, dataclassificatie en integratiemogelijkheden.

• Zorgen voor volledige kennisoverdracht, inclusief broncode, configuratie en technische documentatie, zodat verdere uitbreiding en beheer mogelijk blijven.

• Complexe analyses helder toelichten aan stakeholders met uiteenlopende technische achtergronden.

📝 Jouw profiel

• Je hebt ruime ervaring met data-analyse en het analyseren van datastromen.

• Je hebt sterke kennis van tijdreeksanalyse, trenddetectie en change point detectie, bijvoorbeeld met tools zoals Darts, Sktime of PyTorch Forecasting.

• Je beheerst scriptingtalen zoals Python en/of R; kennis van Shell of Perl is een meerwaarde.

• Je hebt grondige kennis van SQL, databanken zoals Oracle en het optimaliseren of tunen van databases en queries.

• Je hebt ervaring met data modelling, bij voorkeur in een Databricks-omgeving.

• Je beschikt over kennis van LLM en RAG.

• Je hebt ervaring met Power BI voor dashboards, datavisualisatie en data-optimalisatie, en je kan noden van stakeholders vertalen naar passende Power BI-oplossingen.

• Je hebt kennis van gevorderde statistische technieken en concepten.

• Je bent sterk in rapportering en kan bevindingen gestructureerd en begrijpelijk presenteren.

• Ervaring met projecten binnen de overheid is een plus.

title: Retention Lead
description:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo comercial trabaja bajo el modelo híbrido, combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con el intercambio presencial en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México, 3 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El equipo de Retención es responsable de reducir la tasa de deserción y maximizar el valor de vida del cliente enfocado exclusivamente en el portafolio de pequeñas y medianas empresas . Esta es una posición de alto impacto y de nueva creación en México; serás responsable de frenar la principal fuga de revenue de la operación, construyendo los cimientos de la retención a nivel local. Buscamos personas con fuertes habilidades de negociación, empatía y resiliencia para liderar a un equipo de 5 personas.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Dirigir, motivar y capacitar a un equipo de retención de 5 personas con perfil junior (mayormente nivel banda 2), brindando un acompañamiento cercano (micromanagement y coaching) para desarrollar sus habilidades de negociación desde cero .

•
Ejecutar estrategias de retención alineando los descuentos previos a la nueva lista de precios, utilizando palancas estratégicas para contener las bajas minimizando el impacto en el ARPA .

•
Gestionar operativamente el flujo de casos de clientes que solicitan darse de baja, los cuales son escalados a través de Salesforce Chatter por los equipos de SMB, Cobranzas y Atención al Cliente .

•
Monitorear métricas clave de éxito basadas en la cantidad de revenue (importe monetario) retenido y facturado, además del Churn Rate y el Customer Health Score .

•
Conducir y supervisar llamadas consultivas de retención (con una duración promedio de 40 minutos), presentando a los clientes dashboards de productividad y métricas de rendimiento para justificar su inversión .

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Mínimo de 4 años de experiencia en ventas o retención, con al menos 2 años en roles de liderazgo de equipos .

•
Excelentes competencias de Negociación Avanzada para manejar conversaciones difíciles, apoyándose en el playbook de causísticas para cerrar acuerdos rentables .

•
Sólido dominio de plataformas CRM, preferentemente Salesforce, para la gestión de casos operativos y análisis de datos .

•
Resiliencia para mantener un trato profesional bajo presión y una alta capacidad de empatía para conectar con el cliente de forma genuina .

title: Supervisor de Vendas (PI)
description:
O Supervisor de Vendas é responsável por coordenar e monitorar o desempenho comercial de uma ou mais linhas de produtos específicas da Anton Paar, garantindo o alcance das metas de vendas, a saúde do *pipeline*, o acompanhamento estratégico de oportunidades e o suporte direto à equipe de vendas.
Atua como elo entre a equipe de vendas, clientes, áreas internas e a matriz, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas, negociações relevantes, monitoramento de KPIs, previsão de vendas e o desenvolvimento de ações necessárias para o crescimento sustentável da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.
Principais Responsabilidades e Atividades
Gestão da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade

• Monitorar o desempenho comercial mensal da linha, acompanhando resultados de vendas, projeções de receita, oportunidades em aberto e o progresso em relação à meta anual.

• Analisar a saúde do *pipeline* da linha sob sua responsabilidade, avaliando o volume de oportunidades, o estágio no funil de vendas, a probabilidade de sucesso, os prazos previstos de fechamento e os riscos relacionados ao alcance das metas.

• Realizar acompanhamentos individuais mensais com os vendedores responsáveis ​​pelas oportunidades da linha, revisando KPIs, status de negociação, qualidade do funil, prioridades comerciais e próximos passos.

• Apoiar a definição de estratégias comerciais para garantir o alcance das metas da linha, considerando o mercado, clientes estratégicos, carteira ativa, oportunidades em andamento e ações necessárias para o desenvolvimento de novos negócios.

Monitoramento de vendas, previsão (*forecast*) e KPIs

• Monitorar os números mensais de vendas da linha, bem como a projeção de vendas até o final do ano, antecipando possíveis desvios e propondo ações corretivas.

• Monitorar indicadores de vendas, como oportunidades em aberto, progresso no funil de vendas, probabilidade de fechamento, volume de propostas, descontos aplicados, previsão de vendas (*forecast*), conversão de oportunidades e aderência às metas.

• Garantir que as informações relacionadas às oportunidades estejam atualizadas no CRM, permitindo análises confiáveis ​​do *pipeline*, da previsão de vendas e do desempenho da linha.

• Avaliar oportunidades estratégicas com a equipe de vendas, apoiando a priorização de clientes, negociações e ações comerciais de maior impacto.

Suporte à equipe de vendas

• Fornecer suporte direto à equipe de vendas em negociações relevantes, visitas estratégicas, definição da abordagem comercial e acompanhamento de oportunidades críticas.

• Participar de visitas a clientes com os vendedores quando necessário, especialmente em oportunidades estratégicas, negociações complexas ou contas de maior relevância para a linha. Apoiar a equipe de vendas na análise e concessão de descontos, considerando a estratégia de vendas, a relevância da oportunidade, a competitividade, o relacionamento com o cliente e o impacto nos resultados da linha de produtos.

• Orientar a equipe de vendas quanto às prioridades da linha, auxiliando na tomada de decisão sobre quais oportunidades devem receber maior foco e acompanhamento.

• Dar suporte a processos comerciais específicos, incluindo licitações, solicitações de importação e alinhamentos técnicos e comerciais, sempre que relacionados às linhas de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.

Relacionamento com clientes, áreas internas e matriz

• Manter bom relacionamento com clientes estratégicos, atuando como suporte à equipe de vendas em negociações, visitas e discussões comerciais ou técnicas, quando necessário.

• Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas envolvidas no processo comercial, como logística, importação, financeiro, serviços, aplicações, marketing e outras áreas de suporte.

• Comunicar-se com a equipe da matriz quando necessário, incluindo solicitações de suporte técnico, alinhamento de estratégias globais, acompanhamento de importações, priorização de demandas ou apresentação dos resultados da linha de produtos n

About the team

OpenAI is building a new generation of AI-powered consumer devices, creating opportunities to bring increasingly capable AI into people's everyday lives.

Our Data Engineering team is responsible for establishing the foundational data infrastructure that supports the development, manufacturing, launch, and ongoing operation of these products. We're building the systems that connect information across the entire device lifecycle, enabling engineering, operations, and Data Science partners to understand product performance, identify problems, and make better decisions.

This is an early-stage organization with significant greenfield opportunities. We're looking for engineers who want to shape the technical foundations of a rapidly growing business and establish systems that will scale alongside our products.

About the role:

As a Data Engineer, you'll design, build, and scale the data infrastructure that powers OpenAI's hardware and consumer devices organization.

You'll tackle technically challenging problems involving complex data sources, evolving operational requirements, and systems that need to scale from early development through manufacturing and consumer deployment.

Unlike roles focused primarily on supporting individual analytics projects, this position emphasizes building durable, reusable data foundations that enable multiple teams and use cases.

You'll have significant ownership over technical decisions, work closely with partners across engineering, manufacturing, operations, and Data Science, and help define how we approach Data Engineering as the organization grows.

- Enable manufacturing and quality intelligence: Connect manufacturing conditions and production history with downstream product performance, reliability, returns, and failure signals.

- Prepare for scale: Design systems that evolve from early-stage development and initial production to increasingly complex operations and large-scale consumer deployment.

- Partner across disciplines: Work with hardware and software engineers, manufacturing teams, operations leaders, and Data Scientists to translate emerging requirements into robust technical solutions.

- Shape our technical direction: Help establish engineering standards, architectural principles, data quality practices, and infrastructure decisions that will influence the organization for years to come.

- Are comfortable making architectural decisions as requirements evolve and the right solutions aren't immediately obvious.

- Are highly self-directed and can take broad, ambiguous problems from exploration through implementation.

- Enjoy working directly with cross-functional partners and understanding how technical decisions affect real products and operational outcomes.

- Have a builder's mentality and are energized by creating foundational systems rather than exclusively optimizing mature infrastructure.

- Hold a high bar for engineering quality while remaining pragmatic about the speed and flexibility required in an early-stage environment.

title: Digital Product Enablement Specialist
description:
Get started on an exciting career at Element!
Element employees make a difference in the lives of others every day. We are re-defining the fleet management industry to be people first, then business - delivering on our promise of a superior client experience. This takes hard work and innovation, and we need more like-minded people on our team.
Turn digital product knowledge into clear, consistent resources that help teams show clients what is possible.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Digital product enablement helps teams explain capabilities clearly, prepare strong client-facing materials, and create a more consistent experience for prospects and clients.

As Digital Product Enablement Specialist, you will create, organize, and maintain demo materials, knowledge resources, training content, and other digital product assets used by Client Success, Commercial, and Operations teams. You will help make those resources accurate, accessible, current, and easy to use.

You will also support product demonstrations and enablement sessions, build familiarity with the demo process, and gradually take on portions of demonstrations as your capability develops. The role is well suited to someone who combines strong organization and attention to detail with clear communication, curiosity, and a client-focused mindset.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Create, organize, and maintain digital product enablement materials, including demo recordings, knowledge base content, training resources, and related digital assets.

• Support product demonstrations and enablement sessions by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, learning from experienced presenters, and gradually presenting portions of demos for internal teams, prospects, and clients.

• Maintain content organization and version control in SharePoint or similar repositories, using clear naming and storage practices to help teams access current, accurate materials efficiently.

• Support request for proposal (RFP) and sales enablement content by drafting, updating, and organizing digital product responses and coordinating input from Digital Team stakeholders.

• Collect stakeholder feedback, identify recurring questions or content gaps, and recommend updates that improve the quality, usability, and consistency of digital product enablement resources.

YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS ROLE IF:

You bring experience in a client-facing or business support environment and are comfortable turning digital product information into practical, user-friendly content.

• You have experience in client success, sales enablement, product enablement, customer support, operations enablement, or a related client-facing or business support function.

• You have created, organized, and maintained demo materials, training resources, knowledge base content, or other enablement materials.

• You bring strong organizational skills and can manage content, track updates, and maintain accurate documentation.

title: Database Administrator III

• Administer SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases end to end - performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis.

• Manage database security - roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.

• Plan and execute database migrations to the cloud, optimizing configurations for target environments, and ensuring performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition.

title: Electrical Engineer-Federal Engineering & Design
description:
Company Description

We are Olsson . We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results - for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson . It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description
Olsson is seeking a licensed Electrical Engineer to join our Federal Engineering & Design Team. This role independently performs standard electrical engineering techniques and procedures while applying professional judgment to adapt and modify designs as needed. The Engineer receives direction on assignment objectives and complex features and is responsible for executing work using established plans, standards, and federal requirements.
This position contributes to the development of purposeful, high-quality electrical designs that support federal clients, including military, government, and mission-critical facilities. The Engineer collaborates closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, code-compliant, and constructible solutions while supporting project scope, schedule, and budget.
As part of Olsson ’s Federal Engineering & Design Team, this role plays an important part in delivering projects that serve national interests and improve the built environment.
Responsibilities:

• Performs electrical engineering duties related to the evaluation, design, and documentation of electrical systems for small to large-scale federal projects, including power distribution, lighting, grounding, and related building systems.

• Applies standard electrical engineering techniques, methods, and procedures to develop constructible, code-compliant designs while evaluating and proposing minor adaptations to meet project-specific needs.

• Prepares electrical calculations, drawings, specifications, technical reports, and cost estimates in accordance with applicable codes, federal standards, and agency requirements.

• Assists with preparation and coordination of project documents and maintains awareness of project scope, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.

• Coordinates electrical design elements with other engineering disciplines and internal project teams to support integrated project outcomes.

• Communicates project development and progress with project managers and may participate in coordination efforts with federal clients, contractors, and consultants.

• Performs process design calculations, analyzes engineering data, and supports feasibility evaluations for proposed electrical systems.

• Enters, maintains, and updates project information and documentation within Olsson ’s project management systems in accordance with the firm’s Quality Management Program.

• Diagnoses and assists in resolving technical design issues and supports quality assurance and quality control processes throughout project execution.

• May provide technical guidance and oversight to less experienced engineers or technical staff as assigned.

• Travel and participation in project charrettes, design reviews, and value engineering conferences.

• May travel to project sites and work in varying terrain and weather conditions during different stages of construction.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license is required.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with project teams and stakeholders.

• Solid problem-solving,

title: Staff Python Engineer (Contract)
description:
Staff Python Engineer

Independent Contractor Engagement | Remote - Eastern Europe | Data Engineering

This is an independent contractor engagement. This is not an offer of employment.

CONTRACTOR ENGAGEMENT NOTICE: This opportunity is structured as an independent contractor (B2B) engagement. The selected contractor will be responsible for all applicable taxes, social contributions, and statutory obligations in their country of residence. No employment relationship, employee benefits, equity awards, paid leave, or statutory employment protections are created by this engagement. Contractors must hold or obtain the legal right to provide services as an independent contractor in their jurisdiction.

About the Role

Arch Systems is building the future of manufacturing intelligence. Our ArchFX Cloud platform processes millions of IoT data points daily from advanced factory machines worldwide, helping leading manufacturers optimize efficiency, sustainability, and growth.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our data engineering pod as an independent contractor. You'll work with data collected from factory machines and devices - processing, transforming, and preparing it for analytics and visualization. You'll manage and optimize the data pipelines that feed our analytics platform, collaborating closely with our cloud and data science teams to deliver robust, scalable data solutions.

Scope of Engagement

As an independent contractor, you will provide the following services:

• Design and deliver backend features in Python for large-scale enterprise SaaS.

• Contribute to technical excellence through testing, CI/CD, and secure design.

• Provide technical guidance and architectural input across backend initiatives.

• Design data models and pipelines that turn high-volume sensor data streams into clean, structured time-series events, handling late-arriving data, retention windows, and reclassification when downstream rules change.

• Own a sync and reconciliation engine that keeps thousands of distributed edge clients consistent with the cloud, incremental updates on demand, retroactive resync to correct historical state, and atomic merging of concurrent edits without data loss.

• Build integrations between our platform and customer enterprise systems; keep two systems of record consistent under partial failures, late data, and ambiguous record matching.

• Design for correctness under concurrency, interval-based data, transactional guarantees across long-running workflows, and consistency between async workers, polling clients, and human edits.

• Build a configuration system that lets large enterprise customers tailor behaviour without forking the codebase, formula-driven configuration evaluated against a runtime context, with safe extension points for customer-specific logic.

• Build APIs reliable and fast enough to power latency-sensitive operational UIs, endpoints hit every few seconds, where a slow or wrong response is immediately visible to a paying customer.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of professional software development (Python and Django required).

• Experience with large, complex backend SaaS applications.

• Strong skills in modelling complex data systems and delivering scalable solutions.

• Hands-on experience supporting production code and iterating with customer feedback.

• Celery, RabbitMQ, TimescaleDB/Athena, manufacturing/industrial tech background is a plus.

About the Stack

ArchFX Cloud is primarily a Django API server deployed on AWS using Kubernetes, with a PostgreSQL database for all metadata and Athena over S3 for machine data. High-volume machine data is served via a dedicated TimescaleDB time series database and merged with low-volume metadata inside the Django APIs. Customer-facing UIs are implemented as a single-page web app in TypeScript/ Angular. All backend code is written in Python. Background workers run via Celery on RabbitMQ. title: Field Safety Engineer, Germany
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

As Waymo’s first Field Safety Engineer in Germany, you will serve as Waymo’s primary engineering/technical liaison with safety regulators in Germany, working closely with Waymo’s Policy, Legal, and other teams in Germany. You will also work with Waymo’s Field Safety team in the United States to identify and analyze issues that could impact the safety of Waymo’s fleet of autonomous vehicles, with a focus on issues specific to Waymo’s operations in Germany. 

This role is based in Munich, reporting to Waymo’s Head of Field Safety, Europe based in California. 

You will:

• You will serve as Waymo’s primary liaison on post-deployment safety with automotive and traffic safety regulators in Germany. You will work with Waymo’s Policy, Legal, and other teams to establish and maintain proactive outreach and respond to regulatory requests.

• You will work with Waymo’s Field Safety team in the United States to identify and analyze issues that could impact the safety of Waymo’s fleet of autonomous vehicles, bringing your local Germany perspective to help identify and prioritize issues that could impact Waymo’s operations in Germany.

• You will act as the lead for Field Safety issues impacting Waymo's operations in Germany.

• You have willingness and ability to participate in regular shifts as part of a 24/7 Safety on-call rotation, which is an integral part of Waymo’s incident response capabilities.

 

You have:

• Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical degree.

• 10+ years of engineering or other technical experience in automotive or another transportation field.

• Experience with Germany’s automotive and/or transportation regulatory framework and familiarity with expectations when working with these regulators.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with Policy, Legal, Operations, Engineering and other internal teams in UK, Europe and in the United States.

• Strong communication and presentation skills and the ability to establish and maintain professional presence with regulators in Germany.

• Ability to work occasionally in the evenings to collaborate with the US-based Field Safety team.

 

We prefer:

• M.S. or Ph.D. in engineering or a related technical field.

• Experience interacting with automotive and traffic safety regulators.

• Familiarity with autonomous vehicle technology.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly-scaling company.

• Familiarity with SMS, Safety Case and/or UNECE Automated Driving System regulations.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Cloud Platform Engineer at Supabase, you’ll join Cloud Engineering, part of Engineering Operations, and shape the foundations that let engineering teams build, ship, and operate infrastructure safely and independently across AWS and GCP.

This is a role spanning cloud governance, platform engineering, and hands-on operations. You’ll work across AWS and GCP account structure, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), reusable platform primitives, security boundaries, and self-service workflows for engineers.

You’ll be joining at a point where many of these foundations are being actively defined or reworked. We’re looking for someone who can take ambiguous, messy, business-critical infrastructure problems and turn them into pragmatic systems, tools, standards, and written guidance that scale with the company and empower teams to go faster.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Designing and implementing cloud governance across AWS and GCP, including identity, account organization, access controls, and guardrails.

- Building reusable infrastructure and building blocks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to provision and manage infrastructure safely and consistently.

- Creating self-service capabilities that reduce organizational friction and let engineers move more quickly within sensible boundaries.

- Owning resource governance and visibility: management tagging, a trustworthy inventory of what exists and who owns it, and consistent cross-account billing data.

- Developing reusable security primitives, including secrets storage, KMS, certificate management, token vending, direct service-to-service authentication, mTLS, and related platform services.

- Owning cloud-level network and operational primitives: IP address management, DNS, and health signals such as service-limit and quota alerting.

- Establishing and sharing cloud engineering best practices through documentation, internal tooling, examples, and enablement.

- Have 5+ years of experience in cloud governance, platform engineering, and/or operations, have operated production systems at scale, and carried on-call for them.

- Have previously undertaken a significant migration, e.g. rearchitected an AWS account topology, introduced IaC for existing infrastructure, centralized identity/SSO, or brought a second cloud under governance.

- Enjoy building internal platform and self-service experiences for other engineers.

- Are genuinely deep in at least one-ideally two-of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity):

- Tooling & ecosystem: You’re intimately familiar with the breadth of AWS services in general, and IAM/SSO in particular. You know their Well-Architected Framework, and when to reach outside. You have working knowledge of GCP. You use IaC routinely and have run it in production, whichever tool. You’ve probably collaborated with auditors on meeting compliance requirements.

- Software engineering: You write real production code (Go, Rust, or a comparable systems language), and can build reliable, maintainable services. You thrive across all stages of the SDLC, set technical direction, know how to de-risk projects, and produce written artifacts such as RFCs.

- Operations: You’ve run production infrastructure yourself: carried the pager, written the alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix first, and made shared systems less risky over time. You like owning systems, simplifying complex infrastructure problems, and turning best practices into reusable building blocks.

- Are comfortable treating infrastructure as software and have relevant experience with IaC and automation.

- Communicate clearly, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globall

title: Software Engineer
description:
About ComPsych

ComPsych Ⓡ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResourcesⓇ and AbsenceResourcesⓇ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.
About the Role
We're modernizing how ComPsych builds and ships applications - moving to the cloud, standardizing CI/CD, and giving our Software Engineering teams the ability to build, deploy, and own their products end to end. You'll be part of our Cloud Ops team, working alongside your peers there and across multiple application teams to bring consistent, high-quality CI/CD, infrastructure, and deployment practices to the products we ship.
We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who already works this way and wants to help shape how our engineering organization delivers software. This is a high-leverage role: your time goes toward infrastructure design and technical direction across the teams you support, directing AI to build pipelines and automation and validating what it produces before it ships.
What You'll Do
AI changes what your time goes toward. You're still accountable for the full delivery lifecycle across the application teams you support - design, pipelines, security, and production - but your hands-on role in each shifts.

•
Own CI/CD and infrastructure design across the teams you support. Architecture, deployment strategy (blue/green, canary, feature flags), and the specs that direct AI-built pipelines, infrastructure code, and automation - coding yourself when it counts.

•
Decide what needs verification and prove it does the job. Pipeline tests, policy-as-code, and security gates are a design decision, not a default - you validate that they actually prove what they claim.

•
Build shared standards with the rest of Cloud Ops, not one-off fixes per team. Work with your Cloud Ops peers on the common patterns, tooling, and practices that make every team you support faster and safer, and contribute your own experience back into what the group builds.

•
Own application observability and unblock teams in production. Instrument the services you support, tie alerting to product SLOs, and help engineers across teams debug and resolve issues quickly when something breaks.

•
Keep judgment and accountability human. Reviews, deployment calls, on-call response, and what an incident teaches you stay yours, regardless of who or what wrote the code.

•
Raise the bar for how the teams you support work with AI, coaching engineers on specifying, delegating, and validating rather than treating DevOps as someone else's problem.
What We're Looking For

•
You already work this way. Agentic AI is your primary surface for planning and building CI/CD and infrastructure - you write specs it can execute against and catch what it gets subtly wrong, not just what fails a test.

•
You've built and operated production CI/CD and cloud infrastructure at real scale (AWS or Azure), including carrying on-call load, so you know what good looks like independent of who, or what, writes the code.

•
You treat testing, security, and observability as designed-in requirements, not something a separate function catches later. In a system that carries behavioral health data, “it works” and “it's safe” are the same bar.

•
You work effectively across multiple application teams and with your Cloud Ops peers, building practices that generalize rather than solving the same problem differently each time - judgment AI doesn't replace.

•
You have hands-on depth

NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system (BPS) through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the BPS, which serves nearly 400 million people.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American BPS. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

The Standards Developer manages projects to develop quality Reliability Standards that effectively mitigate risks to the BPS. We prefer:

title: Product Manager - Live Operations
description:
At Chaos Theory , we work at the digital intersection of sports, entertainment, and cryptocurrency . We are looking for a rare professional who possesses the blend of deep technical gravitas and high-level product taste. You will be the architect of our live operations - a visionary who understands the market landscape and possesses the technical depth to lead our product journey into the future of competitive gaming .
A Day in the Life
As a Product Manager for Live Operations, your day is a high-stakes balance between immediate execution and long-term scaling.
You start the morning deep in the data of our current community events calendar, identifying friction points and deciding where to pivot to keep our players engaged. By midday, you are acting as a bridge between worlds. You sit down with engineering and analytics to write highly technical specifications; you aren’t just shipping features, you are building the robust, permanent versions of our short-term solutions to ensure our competitive systems and ranked matchmaking infrastructure can scale to new heights.
In the afternoon, you shift to a collaborative leadership role. You meet with global publishing partners and internal stakeholders, using your deep industry experience to guide decision-making. You translate complex platform needs into actionable plans, ensuring that every stakeholder is aligned and that our technical roadmap is executed with precision.
To Succeed in This Role, You’ll Need:

•
Exceptional Technical Gravitas: You must be highly technical, capable of writing specs that go directly to engineering and understanding platform architecture at a deep level.

•
Proven Industry Experience: You have run multiple cycles within the AAA or Indie gaming industry and have a proven track record of managing and scaling live service content cycles.

•
Product Instinct & Design Taste: Beyond following a roadmap, you have the market insight to decide what competitive features we need to build next to stay ahead of the curve.

•
Stakeholder Management: The ability to navigate and guide demanding stakeholders across engineering, analytics, and leadership.

•
Operational Excellence: Experience building structures, rhythms, and technical tools from scratch in a fast-paced environment.

It’d Be Great - But Not Necessary - If You Also Had:

•
Global Market Experience: Familiarity with major international gaming markets and the pace of global product cycles.

•
High-Growth Digital Background: Sharp operational experience from fast-moving, large-scale digital products or consumer-facing platforms.

•
Ecosystem & Systems Scaling: A history of taking existing systems and re-engineering them to be significantly larger, more robust, and more automated.

You Will Be Responsible For:

•
Owning the Live Ops Calendar: Building and maintaining a mature rhythm of seasonal events, tools, and community engagement processes.

•
Technical Specification: Writing and overseeing the execution of rigorous engineering specs and platform requirements.

•
Feature Evolution: Shipping immediate solutions while simultaneously designing the scalable architecture for skill-based play and progression systems.

•
Cross-Functional Alignment: Reducing friction between publishing partners and internal teams to ensure seamless execution.

•
Strategic Advisory: Analyzing market trends to provide expert advice to leadership on necessary changes to our competitive strategy.

Where You’ll Work:
While the majority of the team are based in Europe and Asia, we collaborate around the world to shake things up in one of the most exciting places on the internet today - the digital center of sports, entertainment, and cryptocurrency .
For this role, we offer a Remote arrangement. While we appreciate candidates in similar time zones to our core teams, for the right technical talent, location is not a dealbreaker. If you're the right fit, you're right where you belong.

Job Description:

Job Summary
The Customs Brokerage Representative III is responsible for performing advanced customs brokerage functions to facilitate the timely and compliant clearance of imported shipments. This position reviews and audits import documentation, classifies merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), supports Participating Government Agency (PGA) requirements, and ensures compliance with U.S. Customs and other government regulations. The role requires strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to resolve documentation discrepancies, support customers, and maintain operational excellence throughout the customs clearance process.
Responsibilities

• Prepare and submit customs entries accurately and in a timely manner.

• Monitor and follow up on the customs clearance process for all assigned entries.

• Review, audit, and validate commercial documentation to ensure compliance with customs regulations and customer requirements.

• Classify merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) to support accurate duty assessment and regulatory compliance.

• Coordinate freight movement and delivery to designated locations.

• Communicate documentation discrepancies and clearance issues to customers, supervisors, carriers, and other stakeholders.

• Interface with international and domestic carriers, overseas offices, importers, and government agencies to facilitate shipment processing.

• Resolve finance, billing, and accounting reconciliation issues related to customs transactions.

• Maintain accurate documentation and scan records into company imaging systems while meeting established deadlines.

• Prepare reports, presentations, and analyses using various software applications and databases.

• Research, troubleshoot, and resolve entry processing and documentation issues.

• Communicate effectively with customers and foreign origins through verbal and written correspondence.

• Establish and maintain positive customer relationships while providing a high level of service.

• Conduct internal audits and provide findings and recommendations to management.

• Support weekend and holiday coverage on a rotational basis as required by operational and account needs.

• Perform general customs brokerage, administrative, and data entry functions as assigned.
Qualifications
Required

• High school diploma, GED, or international equivalent.

• Knowledge of customs operations, customs laws and regulations, and government agency requirements.

• Basic understanding of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification system.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.

• Accurate and efficient data entry skills.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet time-sensitive deadlines.

• Must be located within 50 miles of Dallas, TX.
Preferred

• 1+ years of experience working for a Customs Broker or within a customs import brokerage environment.

• U.S. Customs Broker License (LCB).

• Experience working with customs brokerage software and import documentation systems.

• Experience reviewing commercial invoices, packing lists, and other import documentation.

title: Area Sales Director, Central
locationText: Australia, Canada, India, United Kingdom, United States
description:
Remote (US-Based) | ~1-2x/month travel
Nourish is rapidly scaling our national field sales (partnerships) organization, and we need leaders with experience building teams at scale. The Provider Partnerships Area Director will lead five regions, each comprised of one Provider Partnerships Regional Manager (PPRM) and approximately 8 Provider Partnerships Managers (PPMs).
Your role: build a system of great PPRMs who consistently develop high-performing PPM teams, execute with discipline, and scale our field motion with rigor and care.
In addition, this role plays a critical part in engaging, supporting, and delivering our largest health system partnerships - partnering closely with PPRMs, PPMs, and cross-functional leaders to drive adoption, deepen relationships, and represent Nourish with credibility at senior clinical and operational levels.
You’ll translate national strategy into repeatable regional execution, turn insights from the field into action for the broader organization, and play a decisive role in how we grow, hire, coach, and win.
What You’ll Do
Build and Scale a High-Performing Field Organization

• Hire, coach, and develop PPRMs through disciplined 1:1s, talent reviews, and operating rhythms - setting and upholding a clear bar for managerial excellence, accountability, and judgment.

• Ensure consistent regional execution by holding PPRMs to shared standards across performance management, territory strategy, coaching quality, and hiring/ramp - and by driving adoption of core field systems (onboarding, playbooks, dashboards, and input metrics).

• Translate strategy into execution by converting cross-functional priorities into clear, field-ready action plans with defined KPIs, timelines, and ownership at the PPRM level.

• Pressure-test performance in the field through regular field time with PPRMs - observing coaching, reinforcing expectations, and delivering targeted, skills-based feedback.

• Support and help lead enterprise health system partnerships, collaborating with PPRMs, PPMs, and internal partners to drive adoption, expansion, and long-term success, and engaging directly with health system leadership as needed to guide strategy and unblock challenges.

• Act as the connective tissue between field and HQ, partnering closely with Enablement, Ops, Growth Strategy, Product, Clinical, and Marketing to surface patterns, remove systemic blockers, and scale what works.

• Build for scale and culture, identifying emerging leaders, owning high-bar hiring and promotion decisions, and fostering a patient-first culture that attracts and retains top talent.

What Success Looks Like
This is a high-leverage, outcomes-driven leadership role. You’ll deliver:

• PPRMs who consistently operate against clear performance standards and run their regions through systems, not intuition

• Strong, predictable adoption of input metrics and territory discipline across all regions

• Successful onboarding, adoption, and expansion of large health system partners, supported by tight coordination between field and HQ

• Fast, high-fidelity execution of new playbooks, initiatives, and strategic rollouts

• A deep bench of future leaders ready to step into expanded scope as Nourish scales

• Tight feedback loops between field and the broader organization that increase speed, focus, and execution quality

This Role Is a Great Fit If You…

• Are driven by transforming healthcare through better nutrition, with a patient-first mindset

• Thrive as a builder in fast-scaling, ambiguous environments and enjoy creating structure

• Are a manager-of-managers with a track record of developing strong leaders

• Believe great performance comes from clarity, systems, and consistent execution

• Have experience managing managers in a high-growth, field-based sales organization (healthcare strongly preferred)

• Bring exposure to large, complex health system or enterprise partnerships and are comfortable in senior-level external conversations

• Demons

title: Service Manager
description:
About Darkhorse Tech

Darkhorse Tech is a managed IT services provider built for dental. We support 1,500+ dental practices, specialists, multi-location groups, and DSOs nationwide with day-to-day IT support, cybersecurity, HIPAA compliance, cloud hosting, and email security. We are 100+ people who work almost entirely in one industry, which means we get good at it.

About This Role

We are hiring a Service Manager to own service delivery across our Service Team and our NOC.

Read that carefully, because it is the part most candidates miss. This is not a seat where you manage a help desk. You will manage five team leaders, four Technical Team Leaders and one NOC Team Lead, who together carry fifty-two people between them. Your job is not to solve tickets. It is to build five leaders who run their teams well, hold the same standards, and make good calls without asking you first.

If you are a strong technician who wants to keep touching the work, this is the wrong job. If you have managed managers before and you get satisfaction out of watching someone you coached handle something they could not have handled six months ago, keep reading.

What You'll Do

• Manage and develop four Technical Team Leaders and one NOC Team Lead through consistent one-on-ones, clear expectations, and real accountability

• Own the service KPIs across both organizations: response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket aging, and backlog

• Make the experience consistent, so a client gets the same Darkhorse regardless of which pod takes the ticket, and a technician gets the same standards regardless of which lead they report to

• Oversee NOC operations including backup verification, email security, third-party vendor coordination, practice management software updates, and proactive monitoring, and keep NOC integrated with Service rather than running as a separate island

• Serve as the escalation point when a Team Leader cannot resolve a client issue, and then fix the reason it escalated

• Own service delivery for our largest DSO accounts, multi-location groups running dozens of practices, including escalation, SLA performance, and driving consistency at scale

• Review escalation patterns and resolution quality, and address root causes instead of individual tickets

• Establish and enforce service processes, workflows, and documentation standards

• Partner with People and Culture on hiring, onboarding, performance, and retention across the service organization

• Carry quarterly ROCKs on our Service Traction Leadership Team

What We're Looking For

• Real experience managing managers. Not managing a team of technicians. Managing the people who manage the technicians. This is the single most important qualification.

• IT service leadership experience, ideally at an MSP

• Track record of moving service KPIs, and the ability to talk specifically about what you changed and what happened

• Comfort with NOC functions: backup verification, email security, monitoring

• Experience with multi-location or enterprise accounts. Our largest DSO clients expect a different level of consistency than a single practice does.

• Coaching instinct. You develop people rather than working around them.

• Analytical and process-driven. You look at the data before you look for someone to blame.

• Solid grounding in HIPAA, cybersecurity fundamentals, and ITIL principles

• PSA and RMM experience. ConnectWise preferred.

Nice to Have

•Dental or healthcare IT background

• Familiarity with dental practice management software (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental)

• Experience integrating a NOC function with a reactive service desk

•EOS or Traction experience

Location: Remote, anywhere in the U.S.

Schedule: Full-time, standard business hours Eastern, with coordination of Saturday and after-hours coverage across teams

Reports to: VP of Operations

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
The Project Leadership function at Parexel is a critical part of driving success for our clients and advancing clinical research projects. As a part of the Global Project Leadership organization, your work has a direct impact on the projects, teams, and clients you work with, while helping deliver projects to the benefit of the patients we serve.

Parexel ’s defined Biotech Division offers opportunities for seasoned Project Management professionals with a strong background running global clinical trials in a variety of therapeutics. This group focuses specifically on Biotech clients and providing all areas of support to accommodate their unique needs. This is a great opportunity for those in the industry who prefer the flexibility, creatively and problem-solving mindset to successfully support this type of clients.
